RESULT [curation]: The label-free prototype metric discards 20% of ImageNet without loss, matching the best supervised metric (memorization) down to keeping 70-80% of the data. They also find that pruning amplifies class imbalance for every metric except random pruning (App. Fig. 20), and that SSL clusters align with some ImageNet classes but not others.
US [curation]: Two direct rules. (1) The small high-precision base should favour prototypical examples; only once the pool is large should increments deliberately add hard ones (distance from the prototype, e.g. small seedlings, occlusion).
